project_type: React 18.3 + react-router-dom 6.26 + Vite 5.4 SPA, plain JSX (no TypeScript). Campus food pre-ordering app (FoodHerons/UMAK). Backend is Supabase (Postgres + Auth + RLS); a narrow C# order service is a FUTURE phase (Phase C) and is OUT OF SCOPE here.
build_system: Vite 5.4 (vite build). npm. Node v24. No bundler quirks. Dev server port 5173.
test_framework: NONE. package.json has only dev/build/preview scripts — there is no frontend test runner. Verification is the production build plus targeted grep checks. Do NOT add a test framework for this task.
test_command: npm run build   (there is no separate test command; the build IS the gate)
verification_instructions: ALWAYS run `npm run build` from the worktree root c:\Users\paulc\Projects\FoodHerons\.worktrees\phase-b-frontend (NOT the main checkout). Baseline confirmed green today: 75 modules transformed, exit 0. After each feature, the build must still succeed. Supplement with grep checks named in each FEAT's verification. The client must NOT require VITE_ env vars to COMPILE — a missing var is a runtime throw at client-init, so the build stays green with no .env file present.
environment_constraints: Windows / PowerShell. ALL edits go in the worktree c:\Users\paulc\Projects\FoodHerons\.worktrees\phase-b-frontend on branch phase-b-frontend — relative paths resolve into the PARENT workspace, so always use absolute worktree paths or cd into the worktree. @supabase/supabase-js@^2.118.0 is already installed in the worktree node_modules (keep it; do not re-add). Do NOT edit SQL under supabase/. Do NOT touch the main checkout. Never push; commit locally only. Never create .env.local with real values; never hardcode keys.
contribution_requirements: Each feature must leave the build green and be committed locally on branch phase-b-frontend. Stage specific files (not `git add -A`). .env.example is the only tracked env file; .env/.env.local stay git-ignored. Role casing is lowercase student/vendor/admin everywhere in code.
key_patterns: Frontend uses camelCase domain fields; the DB uses snake_case. The ONE mapping layer is VendorContext (snake->camel on read, camel->snake on write). Components read vendors via useVendors() and auth via useAuth(). The cart (CartContext) is client-side, single-vendor, and reads menu through useVendors()/getVendor — leave its logic unchanged. ReviewsModal receives reviews via props from VendorStore. Per-page CSS files exist (e.g. Dashboard.css, Profile.css) — follow that convention for new pages. Order/order_items are READ-only from the client (RLS forbids client writes); all order creation/transition is Phase C. Reviews insert sends ONLY {vendor_id, order_id, rating, text} (student_id/author_name/ordered_summary are DB-filled/trigger-filled).
